question: How did Jimmy Lai's early business differentiation strategy influence his LinkedIn content approach?
transcript_excerpt: When starting his law firm with no experience, Jimmy Lai differentiated by accepting phone calls until 8 p.m. and on weekends, doing law differently than competitors.
